overall.summary: Every RFP requirement is addressed with specifics. Two small clarifications, on out-of-hours support and cost after Year 1, would remove the remaining ambiguity.

client_priorities.title: Continuity over new technology
client_priorities.text: The RFP rules out a database migration and asks for rollout with minimal disruption. Proposals that change NordFrame’s infrastructure should lose points.
client_priorities.suggestion: Completeness vs. RFP set to High

citations.label: RFP, Req. 3
citations.quote: no migration to a new database

client_priorities.title: Decisions will rely on this data
client_priorities.text: The client asks for risks and limitations explicitly because stock decisions will be made from the dashboard.

citations.label: RFP, Req. 7
citations.quote: inventory decisions will be made based on this system

client_priorities.title: Fixed budget and dates
client_priorities.text: A published budget that includes Year 1 support, and a pilot deadline. Deferred pricing or undated plans are a real gap here.
client_priorities.suggestion: Pricing and Timeline stay at Medium

citations.label: RFP, Budget
citations.quote: €80,000–€120,000 total, including first year of support

citations.label: RFP, Timeline
citations.quote: Working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months

criteria.name: Completeness vs. RFP
criteria.description: Every explicit RFP requirement is addressed.
criteria.comment: All 7 requirements, budget and timeline addressed.

criteria.name: Risks & assumptions
criteria.description: Dependencies and risks are flagged, not hidden.
criteria.comment: Three concrete assumptions, each with its effect on the schedule.

criteria.name: Pricing clarity
criteria.description: Price stated, broken down, easy to follow.
criteria.comment: Itemised €102,000 total inside the budget, with Year 1 support as its own line.

criteria.name: Timeline clarity
criteria.comment: Week-based plan mapped to both targets: pilot in Weeks 1–10, rollout in Weeks 13–24.

criteria.name: Data accuracy & validation
criteria.description: Says how inventory figures are checked against reality before anyone relies on them.
criteria.comment: A 2-week parallel run against the existing spreadsheet process before cutover, stated as the way data accuracy is confirmed.

citations.label: Proposal, Rollout Plan
citations.quote: running in parallel with existing spreadsheet process

criteria.name: Problem understanding
criteria.description: Reflects the client’s actual stated problem and goals, not a generic pitch.
criteria.comment: Reflects the 6 sites in Germany and Austria and the client’s goal of not disrupting existing infrastructure.

criteria.name: Scope & deliverables
criteria.description: Deliverables are specific; clear what is and isn’t included.
criteria.comment: Each requirement has its own section with concrete behaviour, such as access enforced at database query level.

citations.label: Proposal, Role-Based Access
citations.quote: enforced at the database query level

criteria.name: Legacy system & spreadsheets
criteria.description: Says what happens to the old legacy system and the spreadsheets after go-live.
criteria.comment: The spreadsheets keep running during validation, which covers the transition. Switching off the legacy system is still not addressed.

citations.label: Proposal, Rollout Plan
citations.quote: running in parallel with existing spreadsheet process

requirements.name: Web dashboard for all 6 sites
requirements.ask: A web-based dashboard showing real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses.
requirements.finding: Live levels across all 6 warehouses, continuously refreshed.

citations.label: Proposal, Real-Time Dashboard
citations.quote: Live inventory levels across all 6 warehouses

requirements.name: Automated low-stock alerts
requirements.ask: Alerts to warehouse managers when items fall below a configurable threshold.
requirements.finding: Per-item thresholds; email or SMS to the responsible manager.

requirements.name: Existing PostgreSQL, no migration
requirements.ask: Integration with the existing PostgreSQL inventory database, with no migration to a new database.

rfp_citation.label: RFP, Req. 3
rfp_citation.quote: no migration to a new database

requirements.finding: Read-only connector to the existing database; no migration or schema changes.

requirements.name: Role-based access
requirements.ask: Warehouse managers see only their own site; HQ staff see all sites.
requirements.finding: Site-level access, enforced in the database queries rather than hidden in the UI.

citations.label: Proposal, Role-Based Access
citations.quote: enforced at the database query level

requirements.name: Onboarding plan for 6 sites
requirements.ask: A data migration / onboarding plan for all 6 sites with minimal disruption.
requirements.finding: Pilot, a 2-week parallel run against the spreadsheets, then 2 rollout batches.

citations.label: Proposal, Rollout Plan
citations.quote: running in parallel with existing spreadsheet process

requirements.name: Support & maintenance terms
requirements.ask: Support and maintenance terms after go-live, including response times and SLAs.
requirements.finding: Response times by severity, included in Year 1 pricing.

clarification.title: Critical support only covers business hours
clarification.text: A “system down” issue gets a 24-hour response but only “during CET business hours”, so an outage on Friday evening could wait until Monday.
clarification.suggested_fix: State cover for critical incidents outside business hours, for example: “Critical issues (system down) are handled 24/7 with a 4-hour response; minor issues within 3 business days during CET business hours.”

requirements.name: Assumptions, limitations, risks
requirements.ask: Clear documentation of assumptions, limitations or risks, since inventory decisions will rely on the system.
requirements.finding: Database access, site contacts and threshold tuning, each with its impact.

requirements.name: Within budget
requirements.ask: €80,000–€120,000 total, including the first year of support.

rfp_citation.quote: €80,000–€120,000 total, including first year of support

clarification.text: The client will need to budget for support from Year 2.
clarification.suggested_fix: Add a line: “Support & maintenance from Year 2: €18,000 per year on the same terms.”

requirements.finding: Pilot in Weeks 1–10 and rollout in Weeks 13–24, each mapped to the client’s target.
